title: Output schema of LinkedIn Jobs Scraper
description: Scraped LinkedIn job listings, with optional company records when scrapeCompanyDetails is enabled.

jobs.title: Scraped Jobs
jobs.description: Job listings scraped from LinkedIn, including detail-page fields when scrapeJobDetails is enabled.

jobDetails.title: Job Details View
jobDetails.description: Same dataset, filtered to the detail-level fields (skills, seniority, Easy Apply, etc.).

companies.title: Company Records
companies.description: Company-level records (size, industry, website), only present when scrapeCompanyDetails is enabled.
